purpose: Inspect the already-sealed eight-cluster development scores before using incomplete theory gates as vetoes, quantify the conservative GP01 elliptic fit, and look for a dynamical-state pattern that can motivate—but not substitute for—a genuine temporal-history test.

primary_source_metadata.title: Universal thermodynamic properties of the intracluster medium over two decades in radius in the X-COP sample
Investigating the turbulent hot gas in X-COP galaxy clusters

analysis_contract.global_elliptic_selection: minimum robust_loss over every valid frozen GP01-ELLIPTIC cell
analysis_contract.object_metric: nominal elliptic loss divided by nominal GP01L-n1 loss for the one globally selected elliptic cell
analysis_contract.rank_statistic: Spearman correlation with average ranks for ties
analysis_contract.rank_p_value: exact two-sided permutation over all 8! outcome-rank permutations
analysis_contract.cool_core_test: difference in mean loss ratio, exact two-sided enumeration of all choose(8,3) partitions

next_experiments.elliptic: Freeze a new development-only boundary-extension grid before reopening raw responses; keep one shared cell across all eight clusters and compare against GP01L, Newton, AQUAL/QUMOND-equivalent spherical control, NFW/Einasto, MOG, and Refracted Gravity.
next_experiments.temporal: Obtain an independently frozen dynamical-history proxy or simulation-derived past-source ensemble, then fit one shared relaxation time and propagation speed; a static morphology correlation is not a telegraph-equation fit.
next_experiments.joint: Test whether one frozen memory parameter explains the dynamical-state dependence of the elliptic residual without per-cluster tuning, and require leave-one-cluster-out prediction.

establishes: the existing spherical GP01 elliptic development fit is valid and reproducible
the best frozen elliptic cell sits on multiple parameter boundaries
a small-sample retrospective association exists between elliptic relative loss and central entropy/cool-core class
does_not_establish: that GP01 elliptic fits better than the equilibrium control
a direct temporal-memory or telegraph fit
permission to tune each cluster independently
